entities.name: Nemesis
entities.description: Novel by Paul B. Thompson, second book of the Masquerade Cycle, set on Rath.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Artificial Phyrexian-controlled plane about to overlay onto Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane Rath is about to overlay.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Home plane of the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Former Weatherlight crew member, now a vampire, shaped by Phyrexians into the new Evincar of Rath.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Former Weatherlight crew member left on Rath, who becomes Crovax's servant.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Sadistic commander of the Predator who prefers servitude to rulership.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Flagship of Greven il-Vec.

entities.name: Kirril
entities.description: Vat priest who manipulated Crovax.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Rath's former Evincar who returns from Mercadia to challenge Crovax and is executed.

entities.name: Abcal-dro
entities.description: Inner Circle member who orchestrated Avila's murder.

entities.name: Avila
entities.description: Daughter of Eladamri, murdered; her body became the basis for Belbe.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Rebel leader named Korvecdal by the Oracle en-Vec.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: Constructed Phyrexian emissary built from Avila's body who sabotages Rath and is killed by Eladamri.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: Enigmatic figure who named Eladamri Korvecdal.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: Vec freedom fighter allied with Eladamri.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: Daughter of Starke il-Vec, freed during the uprising.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Father of Takara en-Dal.

entities.name: Skyshroud elves
entities.description: Elves of Eladamri whom Crovax attacked unsuccessfully.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Phyrexian seat of power on Rath.

entities.name: Dream Halls
entities.description: Where the remaining rebels were cornered.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that escaped Rath.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who opposes the Phyrexian empire.

entities.name: Rathi overlay
entities.description: The overlaying of Rath onto Dominaria.

events.summary: After Weatherlight escapes Rath, Ertai is captured aboard the Predator and Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril shapes him into Volrath's successor.
events.quote: Ertai is captured and held aboard the Predator

events.summary: Abcal-dro has Avila murdered; her body becomes Belbe, a Phyrexian emissary sent to oversee the Evincar succession contest.
events.quote: Abcal-dro orchestrates the murder of Avila

events.summary: Crovax rapidly outpaces rivals in the Evincar succession contest; Greven prefers servitude and Ertai augments himself.
events.quote: Ertai proves no match for Crovax's rapid ascent.

events.summary: Crovax's assault on Eladamri's Skyshroud elves ends in a rout; he consolidates power by impaling dissenting tribal leaders on flowstone spikes.
events.quote: the attack ends in a rout

events.summary: Ertai and Belbe fall in love, Belbe sabotages flowstone production, and the Oracle en-Vec names Eladamri Korvecdal.
events.quote: Ertai and Belbe develop a romantic bond

events.summary: The rebel uprising fails; Takara is freed but the rebels are cornered in the Dream Halls.
Volrath returns from Mercadia to challenge Crovax but Ertai sabotages him.
Belbe helps Eladamri and the last survivors escape to Dominaria; Eladamri, seeing his dead daughter's face, kills her with poison.
events.quote: Eladamri, seeing only the face of his dead daughter on a Phyrexian creation, kills Belbe with poison

events.summary: Crovax becomes undisputed Evincar, Volrath is executed, and Ertai becomes Crovax's mutated servant.
events.quote: Crovax stands as the undisputed Evincar of Rath.

events.summary: Flowstone machinery resumes full operation and the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins.
events.quote: As the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins
